title: The Boy Who Painted Dreams
author: Hamidreza Rostami
short_description: A boy's paintings come to life at night.
long_description: Leo loves to paint, and one night he discovers that his paintbrush has a magical quality—whatever he paints comes to life! He paints stars that twinkle, a moon that glows, and even a door that opens to a dream world. In this magical realm, he meets talking animals, rides flying turtles, and teaches a polka-dot giraffe to paint. But as the night wears on, Leo grows tired and must return to his room. He learns that while the dream world fades during the day, he can always return by painting, and the magic is always with him. A whimsical story about imagination, creativity, and the power of dreams.

main_characters.name: Leo
main_characters.description: A boy with messy dark hair, paint-splattered clothes, and bright, curious eyes. He has a determined expression.

main_characters.name: Purple Elephant
main_characters.description: A small, purple elephant with sparkly wings and a kind expression.

main_characters.name: Polka-dot Giraffe
main_characters.description: A green giraffe with colorful polka dots and a friendly smile.

main_characters.name: Flying Turtle
main_characters.description: A turtle with a smooth shell and wings that allow it to fly.

main_characters.name: Leo's Mom
main_characters.description: A woman with kind eyes and a warm smile. She knocks on Leo's door in the morning.

emotional_journey: Creativity -> Wonder -> Adventure -> Contentment -> Secret joy
